_readme: The paint beats of the homepage story, in order. Edit a label, colour name, colour (hex) or caption here, then run: python3 tools/build-scenes.py. 'scene' is house or kitchen. 'hex2' is a second colour painted in the same beat (exterior trim, kitchen cabinets, deck and balcony railings). 'before'/'before2' are the colours before painting. 'preps' are steps before the colour (the deck is pressure washed, then sanded); 'stages' are the labels shown for each step. 'alsoPaint' lists other parts painted in the same beat (the balcony, with the deck).
